system.description: The tongue of Babel is a secret language of symbols left on buildings, roadside markers, and in certain books that Malkavians use to communicate with one another — warning of danger, marking a safe haven, or noting whose domain is being entered. It is not an exact science, as if anything Malkavian could be. Only those touched by both madness and the Dementation Discipline can learn to decipher it; it cannot simply be taught, only awakened through time and madness.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
